Actions are list, set, update, and delete. Use env_vars for those stored values. Use deploy to publish a Cloud page: only public values are copied

tools.name: eas_dispatch
tools.description: Dispatches one existing workflow file on the customer’s Expo project with the Expo access token supplied in this call. The only action is that dispatch, using token, appId, gitRef, and workflowFile. Use eas_dispatch when the customer wants Expo to run a workflow that already exists on their project.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_project, project, deploy · Private data: project, deploy, export, env_vars, database, files, eas_dispatch, guidance · Public sink: create_project, project, deploy, export, env_vars, files · Destructive: export, env_vars, files, eas_dispatch, status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_project, project, deploy · Private data: project, deploy, export, env_vars, database, files, eas_dispatch, guidance · Public sink: create_project, project, deploy, export, env_vars, files · Destructive: export, env_vars, files, eas_dispatch, status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
